hooks.name: eve-sdl-install-precommit
hooks.description: Auto-installs the AI-DLC SDL git pre-commit hook into this project at session start, so the user never has to copy or install it. Delegates to eve-sdl-install-precommit.sh (plain sh, no bun), which wires a thin pre-commit wrapper into the repo's git hooks dir (honouring core.hooksPath) that execs the shipped .kiro/hooks/eve-sdl-precommit.sh scanner. IDEMPOTENT and NON-DESTRUCTIVE: a no-op once installed, never overwrites a foreign pre-commit hook, and makes NO git config changes. Set AIDLC_SDL_NO_PRECOMMIT_INSTALL=1 to opt out. SessionStart cannot block; always exits 0.
